task.title: Find help and the version
task.shortdesc: Open the guide to the screen you are on, and read which version of the app you have.

context.p: The button with a question mark at the top of a screen opens the guide to that screen in your web browser. Its full name is . at the end of the list does the same.
Many boxes on a form also have a small round button with a question mark. It explains that box.
The version is the number of your copy of . Give it when you ask someone about a problem, so they know which copy you have.

stepresult.p: A page opens with the name of the app and facts about your copy.

info.p: The number follows the word. The page also lists facts about your .

result.p: You have the version to quote.

postreq.p: Next: shows what the other places do.
